instruction: Write simple script to decode process caps
output:
cat > /usr/local/bin/decode-caps.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
PID=${1:-$$}
for cap in CapEff CapInh CapPrm CapBnd CapAmb; do
    if mask=$(grep $cap /proc/$PID/status 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}'); then
        echo "$cap ($mask): $(capsh --decode=$mask 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown')"
    fi
done
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/decode-caps.sh
